description: A singer has two types of concerts he can hold, pop and R&B. Each pop concert will bring in 100 audience members and take 2 days of practice. Every R&B concert brings in 240 audience members and takes 4 days of practice. The singer must bring in at least 10000 audience members and only has available 180 days for practice. If he can at most perform 40% of his concerts as R&B because he likes pop songs more, how many of each type of concert should be created to minimize the total number of concerts?

AudiencePop.definition: Audience members brought in by one pop concert

AudienceRnB.definition: Audience members brought in by one R&B concert

PracticeDaysPop.definition: Number of practice days required for one pop concert

PracticeDaysRnB.definition: Number of practice days required for one R&B concert

MaxRnBProportion.definition: Maximum proportion of concerts that can be R&B

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of concerts (pop and R&B combined) held by the singer"

constraints.description: Total audience from pop and R&B concerts must be at least MinAudience
Total practice days used for pop and R&B concerts must not exceed TotalPracticeDays
The number of R&B concerts must be at most MaxRnBProportion times the total number of concerts
The number of pop concerts must be a non-negative integer
The number of R&B concerts must be a non-negative integer

PopConcerts.definition: Number of pop concerts to be held

RnBConcerts.definition: Number of R&B concerts to be held
